hints.title: Four-Digit Zero Alignment
hints.text: Format all three input numbers into strings of length four using leading zeros.

hints.title: Digit-Wise Minimum
hints.text: At each of the four positions, determine the minimum character among the three formatted representations.

hints.title: Integer Parsing
hints.text: Concatenate the four minimum digits and parse as an integer to automatically strip any leading zeros.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: num1, num2, num3: integers up to 9999
complexity.notes: Fixed four-digit string conversion and minimum calculations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual numeric modulo operations are less readable than 4-digit string formatting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses string zero padding and positional minimum evaluation.
